FUNCTION SECOND_LARGEST ACCEPTS(arr)
  max <- NEGATIVE_INFINITY
  second_max <- NEGATIVE_INFINITY
  FOR num IN arr
    IF num > max THEN
      second_max <- max
      max <- num
    ELSE IF num > second_max AND num != max THEN
      second_max <- num
    END IF
  END FOR
  RETURN second_max
END FUNCTION
